rationale: Internal privilege-set constant semantics (containsAll, toArray, equals, hashCode) adjusted; no HTTP operation outcome evident.
Exception message built via helper and ids copied; same message text and same ids; no observable difference.
Hook resources created during sync now get tracking metadata per configured tracking method (annotation/label) instead of always a label; stored resource metadata visible through API changes.
Debug log construction skipped when debug off; caller already discarded logs in that case. Rollout salt now precomputed string of flag ID; same value.
New optional include-aliases query parameter (default false) on list levels; when true, location levels include aliases field. Default responses unchanged.
Only adds a log line on config reload; no client-visible effect.
Adds model Run setting, run-type parser and renames a parse function in internal vision code; no HTTP operation shown to use it.
VariantAnnotation gains genomicLocationExplanation property with getter/setter, so serialized responses carry a new (possibly null) field.
New Finding method adds deduplicated aliases map to vulnerability, but no caller is in provided files, so whether any response changes cannot be determined.
Max field ID computation no longer pre-registers the initial column ID, so a schema with a field using that ID is no longer rejected as duplicate.
